PRE-REVIEW VERIFICATION against landed code, plus a SEQUENCING FIX.

CITATIONS CHECKED: completion_sidecar.py:206 and :223 are EXACT (both write model: v.get(model)). plan_review/sidecar.py has drifted — the model field is at :611, not :601 (10 lines, from the S1/S2/S4 changes). Minor, but the plan should cite :611.

SEQUENCING FIX — 2932 (S3) now BLOCKS this story, and the reason is specific to the fact that this payload is SIGNED.

This plan stamps capabilities as the effective record from f184 — i.e. the WHOLE ModelCapabilities dataclass — into provider_provenance. As shipped by f184 that record has THREE fields (native_structured_output, prompt_cache_style, supports_thinking). Story 2932 adds a FOURTH, supports_temperature, because Bedrock hard-400s on temperature for some Claude models and rebars Pass-2 verifiers send temperature=0 (measured: us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7 + temperature=0 -> ModelHTTPError 400; without it -> OK).

If this story lands FIRST, the earliest signed verdicts carry a 3-field capabilities object and 2932 then changes the shape of an already-signed payload. That is precisely the argument that got supports_thinking kept on the record in the first place: adding a field after the payload is signed in the field is strictly more expensive than having it there from the first signature. The same logic applies to supports_temperature, so the dependency is now recorded rather than left to luck.

Note this does NOT contradict this storys additive-only / backward-compatible design. That design covers a READER encountering a payload without provider_provenance at all (legacy). It says nothing about the capabilities sub-object gaining a field between two rebar versions that both write it — readers keying on a fixed field set would see drift. Landing 2932 first makes the record complete before anything signs it, so the question never arises.

ALSO CONFIRMED SOUND: the security oracle (base_url with embedded credentials -> persisted endpoint_host is host only, and neither the password nor api_key appears anywhere in the payload) is a genuinely necessary negative control now that dc0d has landed and REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL actually reaches a provider — a credential-bearing URL is a real input shape, not a hypothetical.
